From material source to application – all from one partner

Predictable availability, verified quality, stable supply structures – our solutions at a glance:

  • Recyclate supply

    Structured sourcing and distribution of recycled plastics – application-driven and reliable.

  • End-to-end recyclate supply

    From requirement definition to stable delivery – including customised recyclate development.

  • Digital platform & material search

    Find, compare and evaluate recyclates based on structured data.

  • Material quality

    Making material quality measurable – through data, benchmarks and analyses.

  • Laboratory services & material analysis

    Test, compare and approve recyclates for applications.

  • Recycling as a Service

    Capture, structure and reuse production waste as a resource.

Recyclate use only works as a system

The recyclate market is complex: materials, data, applications and availability are often disconnected.

plastship solves this through an integrated approach:

  • Supply + data + quality
  • Feedstock + application
  • Market + technology

Part of a strong network for the circular economy

Circular economy is built through the interaction of market, material, technology and data. plastship is part of an active network across industry, recycling and solution providers.

The Entsorger Circle is a cross-industry network advancing digitalisation, AI and innovation in the recycling industry.

Our goal in the network:
working solutions for more efficiency, quality and economically viable recyclate use.

Learn more about our network & partners

Our partnerships for plastics recycling

We are committed to the recycling of plastics and the use of recyclates at European level beyond our services. To this end, we work together with initiatives that are committed to an efficient circular economy.
